=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: "Push all pending commits" step (step name in failed check-run context) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `review / codex-agent` check failed on head `8841b40a0934d7150da7bff4bb4172fd5dd80bbc` (run 37387112300). The failure is recorded by the check-run context but the log_tail (16 KB / 200 lines) shows only post-job cleanup with `fatal: /usr/lib/git-core/git-submodule cannot be used without a working tree` warnings — the actual push error is not in the truncated tail.
  WHY: The push step exited non-zero, so the check concluded failure. The `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR` env var is empty, meaning the error-capture mechanism did not record the first error line for this run. The editor cannot diagnose the root cause from the available log tail alone; the full job log is needed. This failure is not related to the LAST RUN DIFF (which only deletes a changelog fragment per §20 consolidation) and likely pre-dates the current head.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "An autofix report with no failed job reads the review job (`codex-agent`), so it is no longer `runs=0`."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh (jq filter selecting the review job)
  Evidence of absence: The change IS present. The jq filter at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:267-274 now uses `--arg focus "$([ "${SOURCE_KIND}" = "autofix_failure" ] && echo 1 || true)"` and selects `.jobs | map(select((.name // "") | test("(^|/\s*)codex-agent(\s*\([^)]*\))?$")))` when no failed job exists. The test `test_intake_reads_the_review_job_when_the_review_run_did_not_fail` in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py covers this path. This is NOT a gap — the deliverable is implemented.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 1
